## Get All Users

Retrieves a list of all users from the JSONPlaceholder API.

**Method:** `GET`  
**URL:** `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users`

---

### Description

This endpoint returns an array of user objects from the JSONPlaceholder placeholder API. It is commonly used for testing and prototyping purposes.

---

### Response

Returns a **200 OK** response with a JSON array of user objects. Each user object contains the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | Unique identifier for the user |
| `name` | string | Full name of the user |
| `username` | string | Username/handle of the user |
| `email` | string | Email address of the user |
| `address` | object | Address details including `street`, `suite`, `city`, `zipcode`, and `geo` (`lat`, `lng`) |
| `phone` | string | Phone number of the user |
| `website` | string | Personal website of the user |
| `company` | object | Company details including `name`, `catchPhrase`, and `bs` |

---

### Notes

- **No authentication required** — this is a public endpoint.
- Returns an **array** of user objects (10 users by default).
- This endpoint is read-only and does not modify any data.
- Provided by [JSONPlaceholder](https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com), a free fake REST API for testing and prototyping.
